name: False Door Trap

source.title: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

disable: DC 32 Thievery check (master) to jam the needle in its housing or Dispel Magic (6th rank, counteract DC 30) to dispel the magical poison.

items.name: Purple Worm Sting
items.text:
Trigger A creature touches the door

---

Effect The creature is targeted by purple worm sting (DC 32 Fortitude save save).

items.name: Purple Worm Venom
items.text:
Venom from enormous purple worms leaves a victim weakened.

Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 5d6 poison damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

text: A hidden needle delivers a magical poison to anyone trying to open the door.
